entities.summary: Cynthia Heller Adams, commonly known as Cindy Adams, is an American gossip columnist and writer. Adams is most notable for her decades of first-hand reporting on personalities from the worlds of entertainment and politics, especially for the New York Post newspaper. She is a lifelong resident of New York City, and is the widow of comedian/humorist Joey Adams.
